[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Loren''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], he was stationed in [[Dorn Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] where he met with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who wrongfully thought was under [[Darth Thanaton]]'s orders. Kallig asked the sergeant about finding the ship [[Starrunner (light freighter)|''Starrunner'']] but the best the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] could offer was to assign Recovery teams, but it still could take months until finding the lost [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Under the Sith Lord's pressure Loren requested that if things were to be to be rushed, they would need help convincing one of the best recovery teams, which was being lead by a disobedient [[Officer/Legends|officer]], who spent their time tracking an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Temple.
